paragraphs.text: # dsh-ui-annotate

> 圈选 DSH 界面上的区域,描述想改成什么样,自动整理成一条改进请求填进输入框。
> Circle any DSH UI region, describe the change, and it l
ands in the composer as a structured request.
中文
## 最近更新

- 新增「标记目标位置」:说不清要挪到哪时,再框一次标出目标位置,消息里带上目标坐标、位移与尺寸差异
- 修复框选位置与实际改动位置不一致
## 它做了什么

- 在输入框工具行左侧(`conversation.input.left`)注册一个裁剪图标按钮,悬停提示「圈选改这里」
- 点击后整屏变暗,拖框选择区域,实时显示 `宽 × 高`,`Esc` 取消

- 松手后先做命中测试,再在必要时向上收拢到能覆盖整个框的容器(仅在覆盖率真的提升时上移),
提取:唯一 CSS 路径、祖先链、元素在视口中的**实际位置**、框选区域占该元素的百分比、
框里还包含哪

些更小的元素(按覆盖面积排序)、class、`role` / `aria-label`、文本、`data-*`、当前样式
- CSS 路径会一直向上拼到**全页唯一命中该元素**为止(有 id 也验证

唯一性),并在消息里明确
「实际位置」与「请落在这个坐标范围内」,避免改动落到相邻元素上
- 弹出面板写「我想把它改成……」:面板里会显示实际位置与覆盖比例,**回车换行**,确认用「发送」按钮
-

想挪位置但说不清挪到哪?点面板里的「标记目标位置」再拖一次框,消息里会多出目标框坐标、
相对位移与尺寸差异;可以「重画」「清除」,不标记就跟原来一样
- 点「发送」后把整理好的消息插入输入框草稿,**

不会自动提交**,你还能再改
- 纯客户端插件:不访问文件系统、不截图、不上传任何东西,宿主侧 `lib/index.js` 是空的
生成的消息长这样:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## 安装
[代码示例省略，未执行]
然后**完全退出并重开** DSH NEXT(客户端插件的 bundle 只在启动时重新扫描、重算 `rev`)。
装完在输入框左侧会多一个 ⛶ 按钮。
不依赖任何宿主侧能力,也不新增端口、进程或权限。
English
## Recent changes
- Added "mark the target position": when you can't say where it should go, drag a second box to mark

it, and the message carries the target rect, the offset and any size difference
- Fixed the picked
position not matching where the change actually landed
## What it does
- Registers a crop-icon button on the left side of the composer toolbar (`conversation.input.left`),

tooltip "圈选改这里" (annotate here)
- Click it and the whole screen dims; drag a rectangle (live `w × h

`, `Esc` to cancel)
- On release it hit-tests the centre point, then climbs up to a container that c
overs the whole frame when — and only while — that actually enlarges coverage, and extracts: a uniqu
e CSS path, the ancestor chain, the element's **actual viewport position**, the frame's coverage of
that element, the smaller elements inside the frame (ranked by covered area), classes, `role` / `ari

a-label`, text, `data-*` attributes, and the current styles
- The CSS path is extended upward until
it matches **exactly one element** on the page (ids are verified too), and the message states the ac
tual position with an explicit "keep the change inside this box" note, so edits stop landing on neig

hbours
- A panel opens for "I want to change it into…": it shows the actual position and coverage, *

*Enter inserts a newline**, and the "发送" (send) button confirms
- Can't explain where it should move
to? Click "标记目标位置" (mark the target position) in the panel and drag a second frame — the message th
en carries the target rect, the offset from the element's centre and any size difference. Re-draw or

clear it at any time; skip it and the result is the same as before
- The composed message is insert

ed into the composer draft, **never submitted automatically**, so you can keep editing
- Pure client
-side plugin: no filesystem access, no screenshots, nothing uploaded; the host half (`lib/index.js`)
gin: no filesystem access, no screenshots, nothing uploaded; the host half (`lib/index.js`) is empty

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then **fully quit and reopen** DSH NEXT — client bundles are only rescanned and their `rev` recomput
uit and reopen** DSH NEXT — client bundles are only rescanned and their `rev` recomputed at startup.
A ⛶ button appears on the left of the composer afterwards.
It depends on nothing on the host side and adds no ports, processes or permissions.
